title: Heterogeneous processing system for federated learning and privacy-preserving computation

pse.problem: The challenge is to efficiently process large volumes of encrypted data in various complex computations involving cyclic, recursive, and dependent operations, which are common in federated learning, privacy-preserving computation, and distributed artificial intelligence.
pse.solution_function: The system performs heterogeneous processing for federated learning and privacy-preserving computation, enabling efficient handling of complex computations with large data volumes, ensuring low processing delay, and high memory utilization.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of multiple processors capable of handling various computational tasks. It supports encrypted state operations and operates on large integer bit-width data.
pse.solution_implementation: The system coordinates the processors to perform cyclic, recursive, and dependent computations in a manner that optimizes resource usage and reduces processing delay. The data is kept encrypted throughout the process.
pse.effect: Benefits include efficient computation, low processing delay, and high memory utilization, which help address the challenges posed by handling large volumes of encrypted data with complex computations.
